terra.problem: The explanation says they confess out loud, but the passage does not specify that they speak audibly.
Calling rejoicing 'the wrong mood' uses 'wrong' about the baker's answer.
The explanation says the words are said out loud, which the passage does not specify.
The explanation says they say the words out loud, which the passage does not specify.
Saying nobody is keeping quiet goes beyond the statement that all their enemies open their mouths against them.
The verse does not say that everything the enemies say is against the writer's people.
The writer says his eyes overflow until the LORD looks down and sees. The text does not say his eyes are fixed on the LORD.
Saying he is not only crying over his own pain implies that he is crying over it, which the passage does not say.
The writer calls from the depths of the Pit. The text does not say he is at its very bottom.
The text says the writer calls from the depths of the Pit, not that he is at its bottom.
Saying the pit is behind him implies that he has left it, which the text does not say.
